axes.model_access:
The official "Models" docs page lists the selectable roster: DeepSeek V4 Flash/V4 Pro, GLM-4.7/5-Turbo/5.0/5.1/5.2/5v-Turbo,
Kimi-K2.5/K2.6, MiniMax M2.5/M3/M2.7 — note the main line is third-party domestic LLMs, not just the ERNIE family;
enterprise users can additionally add third-party model-provider APIs (the official page names the Baidu Intelligent Cloud Qianfan ModelBuilder roster).
Switching goes through the Auto button in the chat box or the model-selection page (the official documents both methods).
axes.runtime:
A full form family (official docs navigation): Comate AI IDE (standalone IDE), VS Code / all JetBrains / Visual Studio /
Xcode plugins, CLI; the enterprise console (permissions/usage/knowledge management/instruction management/open center) plus Deepwiki and AgentHub enterprise pages.
Personal / Enterprise / private-deployment editions come in three tiers (the official FAQ spells out the differences: license management, data reports, large-scale private deployment).
axes.context:
Memory has an official page (cross-session memory); code indexing has an official page (repo-level index);
enterprise-side knowledge management (private-domain knowledge injection). The built-in Explore subagent handles codebase exploration.
axes.permissions:
Accounts run on the Baidu Intelligent Cloud system; the enterprise console has permission management / three-level roles (enterprise admin / department admin / regular member per the enterprise docs);
approval details for Agent file/terminal operations were not verified item by item.
axes.fit:
Good fit: domestic compliance and private-deployment narratives (finance/healthcare customer segments are named by the official side), an IDE full family (including Xcode/Visual Studio that peers rarely cover),
switchable domestic-model roster, enterprise console + AgentHub asset middle platform.
Not a fit: needing an overseas frontier-model roster (the official model page's main line is domestic models), needing BYOK with any personal key
(the enterprise side goes through Qianfan/third-party providers; personal BYOK was not verified).
axes.name_history:
Brand history: Comate (2023-06 invite-only beta on Baidu Intelligent Cloud) → Comate X (2023-08 commercial edition) →
Chinese name "Wenxin Kuaima" (2024-06 brand refresh at the ERNIE model conference); the official sites kuaima.baidu.com and
comate.baidu.com both work in parallel, docs live at cloud.baidu.com/doc/COMATE — when searching, recognize both Comate and Wenxin Kuaima.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md).

**Suggested measurement** (three, each pointing at something the official readable pages do not give):

- **Product independence after the "joining Baidu DuMate" reports** (whether sites/docs/billing still run independently under the Comate brand)
- **Actual boundary of code-context transmission on the SaaS side** (the FAQ only covers completion context; what an Agent sends when reading multiple files is not written)
- **Model-switching freedom in the private-deployment edition** (the official claims support for ERNIE / open-source / enterprise fine-tuned models; not measured)
unknowns:
- The official stance on joining Baidu DuMate (media reports only; no official announcement found; the official site remains active)
- Published filing numbers for the models used (the official docs do not publish them)
- Whether personal BYOK is supported (the enterprise side goes through Qianfan/third-party providers; the personal side was not verified)
- Details of the approval model for Agent file/terminal operations (not verified item by item)
related: Same domestic big-tech coding full family: Tencent's Hunyuan filing number is checkable in official docs; Baidu Comate's model filing numbers are not published by the official side.
Same domestic big-tech coding line: Alibaba runs the "first-party product + full-family Credits" stance; Comate runs the "private deployment, data never leaves the domain" narrative.
Both domestic coding tools: Trae's overseas dual line is active; Comate's main line is the domestic enterprise side (private deployment).
